methods.name: public static final boolean isGregorianLeapYear(int gregorianYear)
methods.comment:
* Returns whether the specified year is a leap year in the Gregorian
     * calendar system.
     *
     * @param gregorianYear a Gregorian calendar year
     * @return true if the given year is a leap year in the Gregorian
     * calendar system.
     * @see CalendarDate#isLeapYear

methods.name: public static final boolean isJulianLeapYear(int normalizedJulianYear)
methods.comment:
* Returns whether the specified year is a leap year in the Julian
     * calendar system. The year number must be a normalized one
     * (e.g., 45 B.C.E. is 1-45).
     *
     * @param normalizedJulianYear a normalized Julian calendar year
     * @return true if the given year is a leap year in the Julian
     * calendar system.
     * @see CalendarDate#isLeapYear

methods.comment: * Divides two integers and returns the floor of the quotient. * For example, floorDivide(-1, 4) returns -1 while * -1/4 is 0. * * @param n the numerator * @param d a divisor that must be greater than 0 * @return the floor of the quotient
